home.hero_lead: Cutting, bending, welding, CNC turning-milling and full-service powder coating for steel structures, machine frames, cabinets and mechanical parts — custom machining from drawings or samples.
home.hero_img_alt: Welding a steel structure at the workshop
home.intro_h3: Nguyen Minh Engineering — one-stop machining and powder coating workshop
home.intro_p: Nguyen Minh Engineering Co., Ltd. provides metal machining and powder coating for factories, production workshops and contractors in the Binh Duong area. From sheet metal, box steel or a detailed drawing, we cut, bend, weld, finish and powder coat within the same workshop, so parts don't have to travel between sites and quality stays controlled at every stage.
home.c1_1_desc: CNC / plasma cutting from DXF, DWG files or hand-drawn sketches. Clean cut lines with minimal burr, for single parts or production batches.
home.c1_2_desc: Sheet bending, hole punching and die stamping. Dimensions are checked against the drawing before moving to the next stage.
home.c1_3_desc: Welding machine frames, supports, steel structures and stainless parts. Welds are ground and cleaned before surface treatment.
home.c1_4_desc: Machining machine parts, bushings, shafts, flanges and replacement parts from samples or drawings.
home.c1_5_desc: We accept 2D/3D drawings, advise on materials and propose a cost-effective machining plan before quoting.
home.c2_img_alt: Powder spraying inside the coating booth
home.c2_1_desc: Degreasing, derusting and surface cleaning — the step that determines how well the coating will adhere.
home.c2_2_desc: A phosphate layer that resists corrosion and improves adhesion between the metal and the powder coat.
home.c2_3_desc: Electrostatic powder spraying, evenly covering edges and inner surfaces with no sagging or blotching.
home.c2_4_desc: Oven-cured so the powder melts and bonds firmly, giving a hard coat that resists impact and scratching better than liquid paint.
home.c2_5_desc: Coated to RAL colour charts or a sample supplied by the customer; glossy, matte, textured or wrinkle finishes on request.
home.c3_1_desc: We review dimensions and recommend cost-effective materials and machining plans before the order is confirmed.
home.c3_2_desc: Parts are assembled into complete units after coating, ready to install as soon as they arrive.
home.c3_3_desc: Coating is wrapped to prevent scratches, and crates are labelled by quantity and marking as the customer requires.
home.c3_4_desc: Delivery within Binh Duong, Ho Chi Minh City and Dong Nai on a schedule agreed with the customer.
home.c3_5_desc: We strip old coating, treat the surface and reapply a fresh finish on used frames, cabinets and parts.

gioithieu.lead: A machining and powder coating workshop located in Khanh Long residential area, Tan Khanh Ward — formerly Binh Duong province, now part of Ho Chi Minh City. We take on drawing-based machining work for factories, production workshops, mechanical contractors and individual customers in the area.
gioithieu.img3_alt: CNC milling machine working a part
gioithieu.img4_alt: Welder working on a steel structure
gioithieu.img5_alt: Work bench with a part in progress
gioithieu.body_p1: Nguyen Minh Engineering operates in metal machining and powder coating. Every stage — from blanking, bending and welding to finishing, surface treatment and coating — is carried out within the same workshop, so parts don't move between sites and delivery time is shortened.
gioithieu.body_p2: We work directly from the customer's drawings. Before quoting, our technical team reviews dimensions, selects materials and proposes a cost-sensible machining plan; anything unclear on the drawing is confirmed with the customer before cutting begins.
gioithieu.capacity_1: Cutting – bending – punching sheet metal from DXF/DWG files or hand-drawn sketches
gioithieu.capacity_2: Welding steel structures, machine frames, supports, cabinets and equipment housings
gioithieu.capacity_3: Turning – milling machine parts and replacement parts from samples
gioithieu.capacity_4: Powder coating: surface treatment, phosphating, powder spraying, curing
gioithieu.capacity_5: Common materials: CT3/SS400 steel, galvanised sheet, 201/304 stainless, aluminium
gioithieu.body_p3: Our customers include production workshops, mechanical contractors and companies in Binh Duong, Ho Chi Minh City and Dong Nai. For repeat orders, we keep jigs and coating specs on file so later batches match the first.
gioithieu.body_p4_html: For a quote, please send your drawing or reference photos to Nguyenminheng.ltd@gmail.com.

dichvu.cokhi_h3: Precision metal machining from your drawings
dichvu.cokhi_p1: We take on both single parts and production batches: cutting sheet metal from DXF/DWG files, bending, punching, structural welding and machined parts. Every stage is checked against the original drawing, with dimensions verified before moving to the next step.
dichvu.cokhi_p2: Common materials include CT3, SS400 steel, galvanised sheet, 201/304 stainless steel and aluminium. If the material hasn't been decided, our technical team advises on the best balance of durability, weight and cost before quoting.
dichvu.cokhi_p3: For orders that need a surface finish, welded parts are ground clean and sent straight to surface treatment and powder coating within the same workshop — no outsourcing, which shortens lead time and avoids scratching during transport.
dichvu.extra_1_desc: We review dimensions and tolerances and propose a cost-effective machining plan before the order is confirmed.
dichvu.extra_2_desc: Parts are assembled into complete units after coating, ready to install as soon as they arrive.
dichvu.extra_3_desc: Coating is wrapped to prevent scratches, and crates are labelled by quantity and marking as the customer requires.
dichvu.extra_4_desc: Delivery within Binh Duong, Ho Chi Minh City and Dong Nai on an agreed schedule.
dichvu.extra_5_desc: We strip old coating, treat the surface and reapply a fresh finish on used frames, cabinets and parts.

quytrinh.hero_alt: A welder working on a metal part
quytrinh.sub: Eight steps, all within the same workshop
quytrinh.intro_p1: A customer's part goes from receiving the drawing to the packed crate without ever leaving the workshop. That lets us control dimensions at every stage, reduce the risk of scratches from moving between sites, and shorten delivery time.
quytrinh.intro_p2: For repeat orders, the jigs and coating specs from the first batch are kept on file so later batches come out exactly the same.
quytrinh.step1_desc: We receive the drawing, sample or reference photo. Our technical team reviews dimensions and tolerances, selects materials and sends a quote with an estimated timeline.
quytrinh.step2_desc: Materials are issued to the exact type and thickness specified, with blanking planned to minimise sheet waste.
quytrinh.step3_desc: Cut from DXF, DWG files. Clean cut lines with minimal burr and heat distortion.
quytrinh.step4_desc: Sheet bending and hole punching to jig. The first part of each batch is measured and checked before the full run.
quytrinh.step5_desc: MIG/TIG/stick welding depending on material, followed by grinding and cleaning the welds.
quytrinh.step6_desc: Degreasing, derusting and phosphating — the step that determines how well the coating adheres.
quytrinh.step7_desc: Electrostatic powder spraying, then oven-cured for a hard, well-bonded coating.
quytrinh.step8_desc: Colour, thickness and adhesion of the coating are checked, quantities counted, parts wrapped and delivered on-site.
quytrinh.img1_alt: A CNC cutting head working a part
quytrinh.qc_p1: We don't push all inspection to the end of the line. After every stage, the part is checked against the drawing before moving on — an issue caught early is fixed quickly, without dragging down the whole batch.
quytrinh.qc_p2_html: Before delivery, the coating is checked for colour, thickness and adhesion; quantities are recounted against the delivery note and wrapped to prevent scratches.
quytrinh.qc_p3_html: If something is off on our side, we redo the part — please let us know with photos as soon as possible after receiving the shipment.
